verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's H200 page documents multi-GPU deployment through HGX H200 and NVIDIA-Certified Systems with 4 or 8 GPUs, and NVLink connecting up to four GPUs. However, that NVLink claim is tied to the H200 NVL variant rather than the SXM part. Rack-scale deployment appears only as 'enterprise rack designs' for H200 NVL. missing for 10: SXM-specific NVLink/NVSwitch bandwidth specs, multi-node interconnect (InfiniBand/networking) documentation, rack-scale reference architecture for H200 SXM, independent hands-on corroboration of scale-out training/serving.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can train and serve at datacenter scale on this part — documented high-bandwidth interconnect (NVLink, Infinity Fabric), multi-GPU systems, and rack-scale deployment

citations.quote: NVIDIA HGX™ H200 partner and NVIDIA-Certified Systems™ with 4 or 8 GPUs
With up to four GPUs connected by NVIDIA NVLink™ and a 1.5x memory increase, large language model (LLM) inference can be accelerated up to 1.7x
NVIDIA H200 NVL is ideal for lower-power, air-cooled enterprise rack designs that require flexible configurations
